image_prompt: A middle-aged aristocratic woman rendered in cyberpunk anime style. She has sharp, angular facial features with high cheekbones and intense, calculating eyes that convey both ambition and emotional volatility. Her hair is sleek and styled in an elaborate updo with metallic neural interface threads woven throughout, glowing faintly with amber and violet light. She wears an ornate Prussian-inspired dress coat with high-tech embedded elements: holographic embroidery patterns, subtle LED trim along the shoulders and corset, and embedded circuitry visible through semi-translucent fabric panels. Her posture is rigid and commanding, shoulders drawn back with aristocratic bearing. Her expression is stern yet distracted, mouth set in a thin line. She has a gaunt, somewhat exhausted appearance suggesting frequent travel and internal turbulence. Her gloved hands show faint circuit-line tattoos at the wrists. The overall aesthetic blends rigid 18th-century Prussian formality with sleek cyberpunk technology, creating an imposing figure of suppressed power and restless aspiration. The lighting casts sharp shadows emphasizing her severe features and the cool glow of integrated tech elements.
book_context: Catherine the Great: A Life (or similar biographical work on Catherine II)
